description: Get transaction history including card programme activity. Standard format returns JSON; tax_export returns a compact CSV with full unmasked addresses, token contracts, vault tokens, sender/recipient details, and tax labels (Koinly/CoinTracker/TaxBit compatible). Use year for annual tax exports (up to 250 per request). Filter by typeGroup, type, category, currency, dates, counterparty, amount, status, hasNote, hasCategory, hasReceipt, and card. For card queries, pass `card` (matches a card by its last 4 digits like "1234" or by a substring of the card alias like "subscriptions"), `cardId` if you already have the UUID, or `typeGroup: "card"` for activity across all cards. CARD_* rows include merchantName, MCC, country, and last4.

card.description: Friendly card filter — accepts either a 4-digit string (matches Card.lastFourDigits, e.g. "1234") or any other string (case-insensitive substring match on the card alias, e.g. "subscriptions"). Multiple cards can match the same alias; all matching cards owned by the user are included.

cardId.description: Card programme card UUID. Use this when you already have the id. For natural-language queries like 'my subscriptions card' or 'card ending in 1234', use the `card` parameter instead.

category.description: Spending category: FRIENDS_FAMILY, GROCERIES, RESTAURANTS, SHOPPING, TRAVEL, SALARY, etc.

counterparty.description: @username, wallet address, wallet name, IBAN, external provider (e.g. 'Coinbase'), or card merchant name (matches CARD_PURCHASE / CARD_ATM_WITHDRAWAL / CARD_REFUND rows by their `merchantName`). Use this for 'who was this transaction with' queries; use `search` for free-text catch-all.

direction.description: Direction relative to the user: incoming (you received), outgoing (you sent), or exchange (internal swap).

format.description: "standard" (default): JSON with direction, amount, counterparty. "tax_export": compact CSV with sent/received amounts, token addresses, sender/recipient with full unmasked addresses, user address, and tax labels. Use with year param for annual exports.

hasCategory.description: Filter by category presence. false = uncategorized transactions. true = only categorized.

hasNote.description: Filter by note presence. false = missing notes (for bulk annotation). true = only annotated.

hasReceipt.description: Filter by receipt presence. false = no receipt attached (e.g. to chase missing receipts). true = has a receipt.

limit.description: Max results (standard: default 5, max 10; tax_export: default 50, max 250)

search.description: Free-text substring search across transaction notes, raw reference fields, and card-transaction merchant names (case-insensitive). Use this for natural-language queries like 'Lidl' or 'rent' that could appear in any user-visible description of a transaction.

sort.description: Sort: newest/oldest by date, amount_desc/amount_asc by raw amount (default: newest)

status.description: Status filter. Default hides PENDING/FAILED (returns COMPLETED + COMPLETED_DELAYED). Pass "all" to return every status.

transactionHash.description: Exact transaction hash (0x prefix optional, case-insensitive). Returns at most one transaction.

type.description: Exact TransactionType: TRANSFER, SWAP, DEPOSIT_YO, WITHDRAWAL, ON_RAMP, OFF_RAMP_BANK, etc.

typeGroup.description: Group filter: transfer, exchange, deposit, withdrawal, earnings, topup, offramp, card, trade (crypto/stock buys and sells; rows carry a `trade` block with fills, fees and failure)

year.description: Tax year (e.g. 2025). Filters Jan 1 – Dec 31. Overrides startDate/endDate.

name: get_transactions
